image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a printed restaurant menu page. The menu features a large central photograph of a dish (appearing to be fried tofu or fish cakes with vegetables) inside a circular frame. Above the image is the restaurant name in stylized red and green characters, followed by English text 'Hokkaido Ramen Santouka'. Below the image are lines of text describing items and prices, though they appear blurry and illegible. The menu is encased in a clear plastic sleeve or binder, visible on the left edge.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI-generated menus, the failure to render coherent text is a primary indicator of synthetic origin. Evaluate if the blurriness is a depth-of-field effect (natural) or a generation failure (artifact). The text here appears uniformly degraded regardless of focal plane, suggesting artifact. Also, verify if the food image looks like a real photograph pasted in or an AI-generated approximation.
